u4.x.beat: “Stocks beating buy&hold” = share of stocks where the strategy’s excess Sharpe beats simply holding. Only above 50% does the strategy help overall.
u4.x.half: In-sample = first half, out-of-sample = second half.
u4.x.persist: is the rank correlation, across stocks, of “how much the strategy beats holding” in-sample vs out-of-sample. Near 0 means stocks that did well in-sample do not do better out-of-sample —
u4.x.luck: picking stocks by past backtests is mostly luck.
u4.x.top: “In-sample top 10% → OOS” takes the best 10% of stocks in-sample and shows how they do out-of-sample versus all stocks (grey number).
